description: What the page is allowed to reach in the shell. The app's own commands are not listed: those are the ones declared in main.rs, and declaring them is the permission. This is only for the toolkit's built-in channels, and the reader needs three: the event stream the shell announces tabs, settings and menu commands over, and the two the toolbar needs in order to behave like the title bar it stands in for. `data-tauri-drag-region` in index.html is only half of that -- the script it arms ends in one of these two invokes, and an invoke that is not listed here is refused with no sign of it outside the webview console.
